answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 35683 Country: India Title: Is Janazah salah allowed inside the Eidgah by keeping the Janazah inside the Eidgah? Please suggest Question: Is Janazah salah allowed inside the Eidgah by keeping the Janazah inside the Eidgah? Please suggest. Answer ID: 35683 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1931/1360/L=1432) Yes, it is lawful to offer Janazah salah by putting the dead body inside Eidgah. وقيد بمسجد الجماعة لأنها لا تكره فى مسجد أعدلها وكذا فى مدرسة ومصلى عيد لأنه ليس لها حكم المسجد فى الأصح الا فى جواز الاقتداء وان لم تتصل الصفوف . (طحطاوى: 1/326) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
